_comment: startMs/endMs are RELATIVE TO public/narration.mp3, written by capture/space-narration.mjs from the raw ElevenLabs take (public/narration.raw.mp3) and the holds in `spacing`. text/spoken are number-gated against results/demo, results/demo-empty and external-facts.json. Editorial rules: nothing negative about Brand24; cents are spoken in words; no monid_usd, no WoW claim, no PicPay figure. Lines the pictures already say are cut, not narrated.

measured.method: capture/space-narration.mjs from narration.raw.mp3 (silencedetect noise=-40dB d=600ms), holds from spacing.gapsMs

narration.text: Brand24. Social listening. Twenty-five million sources. Mentions. Sentiment. Share of voice. Reports.
A Team seat: three hundred forty-nine dollars a month.
Rebuilt on Monid. One key. One balance. Seventeen hundred tools, paid per call.
This is sonar. One brief: a brand, three competitors, fourteen days, ten sources.
Forty-two calls. Three hundred forty-one mentions. Sentiment and share of voice, each with an interval.
Total: two dollars and twenty cents. Four briefs a month: eight dollars eighty-one.
Thirty-nine point six times under the seat.
When data is thin, sonar abstains. Our own label audit, zero point eight four, printed on the receipt.
The receipt is the product. The code is open. Hashtag monid.

spacing._comment: Silence before the first word, then one hold per gap between cues, in ms. Long holds are where a stamp or a sequence plays on music alone: before KILLED, across the ledger and the typed call, across the topic and voice cards, before the ratio, before the outro.
